def: Deliberate use of an AI system by people to cause harm, such as cyberattacks, fraud, weapons development or abusive content, as distinct from harm caused by the system’s own failures.
practice: Much misuse uses ordinary-looking requests, so defenses layer safety training, classifiers, account-level abuse detection and monitoring; NIST AI 800-1 (second public draft, January 2025) gives guidance for foundation models.
